title: Do we need bees to eat? Four claims: true or myth?
subtitle: Vanishing hives, wheat, chocolate: four claims about bees and our food, true or myth, and how much of our plate really needs pollinators.
form: quiz on_canvas True/Myth over a sequence
notes: OWID has no beehive chart: the hive claim (+85 % managed colonies, 1961→2017) is FAOSTAT via Phiri et al. 2022 (Sci Rep). Claims 2–4 and the payoff (≈35 % of food by weight, −5 to 8 % production without pollinators) from OWID's pollinator-dependence article; 'three in four of the leading food crops' and 'wind or themselves' worded per review. Cocoa midges: Wikipedia/literature. Buttons placed with buttons_at; payoff is a plate drawn as a pie (sectors).
